text:
marco_sales: inbound from a regulated payroll provider. asks: can we run a 2-week EU-only POC (no cross-border egress) on Hosted without buying Dedicated? need clear answers for RFP.
naomi_se: tl;dr: Hosted supports region affinity routing but not absolute residency guarantees. we can do a limited-scope POC with operational controls to minimize cross-region flows.
tariq_ops: here's what we can do for a POC: create a scoped routing policy for the tenant that prefers eu-west-1 nodes and disables automatic cross-region fallback for the POC window. note: this is a manual change and must be reverted at the end. we'll also enable netflow logging and a temporary KMS audit mode.
marco_sales: do we have a sample request header to show them how to instruct region preference?
naomi_se: sample:```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}
x-tenant-id: payroll-acme
x-region-preference: eu-central-1
```
This sets preference but does not enforce cryptographic key residency.
alina_legal: for the RFP answer: recommend wording: "Redwood Inference provides tenant-scoped regional affinity for hosted deployments; however, cryptographic and contractual guarantees for exclusive in-region processing are available via Dedicated or Private (BYOK/HSM). During a timeboxed POC, Redwood can implement a scoped operational policy to constrain routing; this is agreed in writing and monitored via netflow and KMS logs."
marco_sales: cost delta? they will ask procurement.
tariq_ops: quick guidance: hosted = per-usage. scoped POC policy is free for short periods but requires a support-engagement and on-call hours. converting to Dedicated to remove residual risks typically increases unit costs ~3x but depends on model & commit.
marco_sales: any sub-processor issues? customer needs list and whether any EU subproc have US-based backups.
ariqi_ops: small correction: we do replicate logs to a long-term archive which is stored in a regional logging service with EU replicas. some vendor dashboards (third-party monitoring) are multi-region; we can provide a subset export for the POC. alina_legal: i'll prepare a short sub-processor annex for the RFP.
deploy-bot: ticket created: RD-POC-509 assigned to @tariq_ops for scoped routing policy. start date request: 3 business days.
marco_sales: great. i'll draft the RFP snippet and post it here.
naomi_se: one more note: for strict non-egress requirements they should evaluate Private (on-prem/VPC). we can provide a migration checklist to move from Hosted POC to Private Dedicated later.
